scope: Independent D32 synthesis and acceptance-tool design review, plus exact nine-contract Interop binding follow-up. Research/detailed-design acceptance only; no product execution, merge receipt or separate GitHub approval identity.

findings.subject: Incomplete subject input snapshot
findings.original_behavior: A snapshot with only Plan:README.md could accept R01 while R01 report bytes were corrupted; no own outputs or packet were required.
findings.correction: required_paths requires own outputs and packet, referenced design/research outputs and contract specs; every snapshot row now has a matching repository source commit and exact git object bytes.

findings.subject: Wrapper could override the actual independent report
findings.original_behavior: A wrapper could claim accepted while the referenced actual report explicitly said rejected, listed a blocker and reviewed another task. Only reviewer string equality was checked.
findings.correction: review_bindings normalizes actual report decision, all recognized blocker arrays including remaining_blocking_findings, exact subject row, own reviewed path hashes, contract identity and any retained task semantic projection.

findings.subject: Stage-based exact-binding attestation bypass
findings.original_behavior: Any number of accepted subjects in review_ready could skip final attestation; removing completion_stage defaulted to review_ready.
findings.correction: Every accepted subject requires exact evidence/review hash attestation regardless of completion stage; verify_attestations bypass parameter removed.

findings.subject: New historical run overwrote preserved aggregate streams
findings.original_behavior: history_gate wrote verification/frozen-history/<tool>.stdout also referenced by an older results.json; the shared source-lifecycle stdout actually mismatched that preserved aggregate.
findings.correction: Current execution streams now use verification/current-gates/frozen-history, and original frozen-history files have been restored. All original aggregate stream hashes now match.

findings.subject: Acceptance index source and authorization consistency
findings.original_behavior: The preparation/application path did not compare the index source/product labels with actual values/snapshots; current verification did not validate exact index subject coverage. This was found by source inspection.
findings.correction: Shared verify_acceptance_index enforces allowed state, product false, exact subjects, value source and every snapshot repository source. Current verification selects the actual accepted subjects; preparation/application verifies the whole prepared batch.
